fact: Werz Saltbaron is a merchant whom the party previously saved from an assassination attempt.
source_quote: The party then paid a visit to Werz Saltbaron, the merchant they had previously saved from an assassination attempt.
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron greeted the party with surprise and relief that they were still alive.
source_quote: He greeted them with genuine surprise and relief that they were still alive.
subject: Werz greets party

fact: Werz Saltbaron rewarded each member of the group with an obsidian gemstone worth ten gold pieces.
source_quote: rewarding each member of the group with an obsidian gemstone worth ten gold pieces.
subject: obsidian gemstone

fact: Zalthir asks whether the gem reward includes the flumph and the ghost.
source_quote: Zalthir asks whether "each" includes the flumph and the ghost.
subject: Zalthir asks about gems

fact: The flumph plays with its gem using its tentacles, gets bored, and drops it.
source_quote: The flumph plays with its gem using its tentacles, gets bored, and drops it
subject: Flumph drops gem

fact: Daz picks up the gemstone dropped by the flumph.
source_quote: Daz picks it up.
subject: Daz picks up gem

fact: The ghost cannot pick up its gemstone.
source_quote: The ghost can't pick up its gem
subject: Ghost cannot pick up gem

fact: The ghost insists that Gyrgum deposit its gemstone in his grave in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: insists that Gyrgum, who carries his bones, deposit it in his grave in Blingdenstone.
subject: Ghost requests burial

fact: Gyrgum suggests the ghost haunt the gem, but this idea fails because Gyrgum claims he already tried it.
source_quote: Gyrgum's idea that the ghost haunt the gem fails: "Trust me, I tried."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Werz Saltbaron offers to cover the party's lodging expenses at the local tavern.
source_quote: do not worry about those fees. They considered them covered.
subject: Werz covers lodging

fact: Daz perceives that Werz is being overly flattering to set up a request for a favor, rolling a 17 on insight.
source_quote: Daz perceives that Werz is being overly flattering to set up a request for a favor (Daz rolled 17 on insight
subject: Daz

fact: Werz Saltbaron claims to have no idea why he is on the Empty-Scabbard Killers' list of targets.
source_quote: claimed to have no idea why
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron states that he thought the assassin's guild was a children's story until they tried to kill him.
source_quote: "I'd heard there was an assassin's guild, but thought it was a children's story until, well, they tried to kill me."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron reveals a suspicious depth of knowledge about how assassins operate.
source_quote: "assassins are not your enemy. They are professionals."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Daz reads that Werz Saltbaron knows way too much about working with assassins.
source_quote: Daz rolls an 18 and reads that Werz "knows way too much about working with assassins."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Daz theorizes that Werz Saltbaron might be in the find out phase.
source_quote: Daz theorizes Werz "might be in the find out phase."
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum suggests Werz Saltbaron may have stiffed an assassin on the bill.
source_quote: Gyrgum suggests he may have stiffed an assassin on the bill.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Werz Saltbaron claims the Stone Guard would consider the existence of the assassin's guild a children's tale.
source_quote: He says "they would never believe me. They would consider it a children's tale."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: The Deepking has decided that the weaponsmithing monopoly will be held only by his family's clan.
source_quote: The Deepking has decided the weaponsmithing monopoly will be held only by his family's clan.
subject: Deepking

fact: The Deepking has grown more paranoid because of his friend Shal.
source_quote: He has grown more paranoid because of his friend Shal
subject: Shal

fact: People who compete with the Deepking's trade have been disappearing.
source_quote: "people have been disappearing… People who compete with his trade."
subject: Disappearing competitors

fact: Werz Saltbaron admits he might have helped some clans sell goods on the down low.
source_quote: "if I did help some clans sell some goods on the down low, that's no reason to kill me."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Gyrgum remarks that Werz Saltbaron's admission sounds like reason enough to be killed.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "It sounds like it was reason enough."

fact: Werz Saltbaron suggests Clan Ironhead might also be the one hiring the assassins.
source_quote: Werz suggests Clan Ironhead might also be the one hiring the assassins.
subject: Clan Ironhead suspicion

fact: Werz Saltbaron attempts to hire the party to eliminate the assassins targeting him, offering future trade favors in Blingdenstone as compensation.
source_quote: offering future trade favors in Blingdenstone as compensation.
subject: Werz hires party

fact: Thorin suggests Werz hire the assassins to kill other assassins.
source_quote: Thorin: "Why don't you hire the assassins to kill the assassins?"
subject: Thorin

fact: Werz Saltbaron states that hiring assassins to kill assassins would be expensive.
source_quote: Werz: "That would be expensive."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Thorin accuses Werz of using the party as cut-rate assassins.
source_quote: Thorin: "So you're just using us as cut-rate assassins."
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum proposes using Werz Saltbaron as bait to catch the next assassin.
source_quote: Gyrgum proposes using Werz as bait to catch the next assassin.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Werz Saltbaron refuses to act as bait because he claims not to be a heroic individual.
source_quote: Werz refuses: "I'm not that kind of heroic individual."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron notes that the party arrived with gnomes and that some members do not look like they belong in the Underdark.
source_quote: Werz notes the party arrived with gnomes, that "some of you don't look like you belong in the Underdark,"
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron suggests the party may end up in Blingdenstone needing a favor.
source_quote: that they may end up in Blingdenstone needing a favor.
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Members of the Stone Guard have recently begun accepting bribes.
source_quote: Werz also reveals that members of the Stone Guard have recently been taking bribes
subject: Stone Guard

fact: The Stone Guard was previously noted for their absolute integrity and were described as very boring.
source_quote: "The Stone Guards were always noted for their absolute integrity… They were very boring that way."
subject: Stone Guard

fact: Werz Saltbaron places the corruption of the Stone Guard in the same timeline as the rest of the city's recent craziness.
source_quote: He places the change in the same timeline as the rest of the city's recent craziness
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron suggests the party could offer the guards money if they get into trouble.
source_quote: suggests the party could always offer the guards money if they get into trouble.
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron warns that he would not tell Errde about the bribes if he wanted to keep his head.
source_quote: He adds that he "wouldn't tell Errde this if I wanted to keep my head."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron clarifies that the assassins must stop being a problem for him while he remains alive.
source_quote: the assassins must stop being a problem for him, "But with me still alive."
subject: Werz clarifies terms

fact: Werz Saltbaron frames the arrangement as trade based on comparative advantage.
source_quote: "A comparative advantage, I am told, is a property that results in better outcomes for everyone."
subject: Werz Saltbaron

fact: Werz Saltbaron warns that Gracklstugh is a tinderbox where the right information could ignite all-out war.
source_quote: Werz warns the party that the city is a tinderbox, and that providing the right information to the right people at the right time could ignite an all-out war.
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Thorin asks if telling everybody everything would be bad.
source_quote: Thorin: "So telling everybody everything would be bad?"
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum states that the party has already been paid not to tell people about the situation.
